about.headline: We sell the devices, and we fix them, in the same shop
about.introBody: Roze Mobiles & Computers isn't just an electronics shop. Here in Jubaiha, Abu Nsair Street, Building 157, the idea is simple: you need a new device, then you need repair. Why visit two places?
about.storyBody: Here you can buy the latest phones, laptops, and devices. And if your device breaks or needs repair, you can bring it to us in the same place. We diagnose the problem, fix it, and return the device quickly.
about.trustBody: The Google rating doesn't lie. 159 customers are happy with us. We listen to their feedback, learn from it, and improve.
about.hoursBody: 10am to midnight every day, Sunday through Thursday. Friday from 1pm. We know people are busy during work — we stay late so you can visit before heading home.
about.visitBody: Nothing beats seeing the real thing. You can see the devices in person, try them out, ask questions, and talk to the team face-to-face. Location: Jubaiha — Abu Nsair Street — Building 157, Amman.

faq.headline: Questions you might have
faq.q1_answer: If the device is in stock, we can have it to you by tomorrow. If it's not in stock, we'll tell you exactly when it will arrive. No false promises here.
faq.q2_answer: Yes, we accept cash on delivery. A small deposit when you order, then pay the rest when your order arrives.
faq.q3_title: Can I pay by card or online?
faq.q3_answer: Not yet. We accept cash on delivery or we can arrange it with you over WhatsApp. Card payments are coming soon.
faq.q4_title: How long does a repair take?
faq.q4_answer: It depends on the problem. A screen repair can take 48 hours. Other issues vary. When you bring the device, we'll tell you the exact timeline.
faq.q5_title: Is there a warranty on repairs?
faq.q5_answer: Yes. Every repair we do comes with a warranty written on the receipt. Keep the receipt — it has all the details.
faq.q6_title: Do you have the device I want?
faq.q6_answer: Likely. We carry phones, laptops, and gaming devices. Ask on WhatsApp — even if we don't have it today, we can get it for you.
faq.q7_answer: Sunday to Thursday, 10am to midnight. Friday from 1pm to midnight. Closed Friday morning.
faq.q8_title: How do I track my order?
faq.q8_answer: Easy. Go to the order tracking page, enter your order number and mobile number, and see the status. If something's unclear, call us.

howToBuy.headline: Your steps to getting the device
howToBuy.step1_body: Go to the site and check out the categories. Phones, laptops, gaming devices — everything is organized.
howToBuy.step2_body: Found the device you want? Add it to your cart and keep shopping or go to checkout.
howToBuy.step3_body: Enter your name, mobile number, and address. We need accurate information to deliver your order.
howToBuy.step4_body: Pay on delivery or send your order via WhatsApp. If you choose WhatsApp, we'll message you to confirm the final price.
howToBuy.step5_body: Either way, we'll call you to confirm your order details and delivery address.
howToBuy.step6_body: After confirmation, go to the order tracking page anytime. Enter your order number and mobile to see where your order is.
howToBuy.step7_body: Order arrived? Pay on delivery if you chose that option, or receive it from the courier.
howToBuy.whatsappNote: If anything is unclear at any step, message us on WhatsApp and we'll help.

warranty.headline: Device and repair warranties
warranty.devicesBody: Every device you buy from us comes with a manufacturer or distributor warranty. Keep your receipt — it has all the details. If there's an issue, you can return it within the warranty period.
warranty.repairsBody: Every repair we do comes with a warranty written on the receipt. Keep it. If there's any issue after repair, you can bring it back within the warranty period.
warranty.policyNote: <!-- CLIENT: Insert your complete warranty policy here. Include specific warranty periods for each type of repair, conditions, and exceptions. -->
warranty.moreInfoBody: For details on a specific repair warranty, call our maintenance line. We'll tell you the exact warranty period and conditions.
warranty.introBody: Warranty depends on the device and the service. Here is what is covered, what to keep, and who to call for the exact term on your repair.

privacy.headline: How we handle your information
privacy.introBody: We respect your privacy. Here's what we do with your information.
privacy.orderDataBody: When you order, we need your name, phone number, and address. We use this to deliver your order. We don't share it with anyone else unless it's necessary for delivery.
privacy.cartBody: Your cart is stored in your browser (local storage). We don't send this data to another server. It's automatically cleared when you clear your browser cache.
privacy.trackingBody: You can track your order with your order number and phone number. We don't keep a long history of orders — only the delivery period.
privacy.whatsappBody: If you choose WhatsApp, your information goes to WhatsApp's servers. Read WhatsApp's privacy policy to see how they handle your information.
privacy.advertisingBody: We don't use visitor analytics or ad tracking. We don't send information to Google Analytics or anyone else. Only data you give us directly.
privacy.cookiesBody: We don't use cookies for tracking or ads. We might use simple technical cookies to store language preferences or session state, but they don't contain personal information.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy questions, call us directly on mobile or WhatsApp.
